column1: # comment: "Employment alignments \u2014 the reified Employment relator, employment type, compensation, and seniority to schema.org, Wikidata, W3C ORG, ResumeRDF, ESCO, and CTDL. Role, Occupation, Membership, and Credential mappings live in their respective mapsets (gmeow-classes, gmeow-properties, gmeow-wikidata)."

column7: ORG Role covers any role in an organization, including employment; GMEOW Employment is specifically the employment relationship.
GMEOW Employment is a reified relator (membership + role + compensation + type); schema:EmployeeRole is a flatter role construct.
schema:OrganizationRole is broader than EmployeeRole; GMEOW Employment is employment-specific.
Wikidata P108 is the flat employer property; GMEOW Employment is the reified relator. Class-to-property alignment is intentional but cross-category, hence relatedMatch.
Wikidata salary property; GMEOW uses MonetaryAmount with currency frame.
GMEOW compensation is a MonetaryAmount with explicit currency frame; schema:salary is a broader, flatter construct.
ESCO occupation taxonomy aligned to GMEOW Employment via employmentOccupation.
GMEOW uses a value vocabulary (EmploymentType individual); schema.org uses a string.
